high_level_description: This image captures a stunning cityscape at sunset or sunrise, with the sky filled with dramatic clouds that range from dark gray to lighter shades of blue and orange. The city skyline is illuminated by the warm, golden light of the sun, which is either rising or setting behind the buildings, casting a beautiful glow on the skyscrapers and reflecting off the water below. The city appears to be modern, with numerous high-rise buildings, some of which have reflective glass facades that catch the sunlight.
